        <script><![CDATA[var InvstWorkAssociationBase = Class.create();
InvstWorkAssociationBase.prototype = Object.extendsObject(InvstBase, {
	TABLE: "sn_invst_pln_invst_work_association",
    initialize: function(workAssociationRecordOrSysId,isSecure) {
		InvstBase.prototype.initialize.call(this, this.TABLE, workAssociationRecordOrSysId,isSecure);
    },
	
	fetchAllQueriedWorkItemRecords: function(table, encodedQuery) {
		var gr;
		gr = this.isSecure ? new GlideRecordSecure(table) : new GlideRecord(table);	
		gr.addEncodedQuery(encodedQuery);
		gr.query()
		return gr;
	},
	
	getFundingSourceTable: function(fundingEntity) {    
        var grFe= this._getGR('sn_invst_pln_invst_funding_entity',fundingEntity);
        return grFe.getValue('entity_table');
    },
	
	_getGR: function(table,sysId){
		var gr=new GlideRecord(table);
		gr.get(sysId);
		return gr;
	},

    type: 'InvstWorkAssociationBase'
});]]></script>
